source_clause: PRACC8.) There can be up to five (5) Driver Profiles per vehicle, plus a Valet Mode Profile. When the Maximum number of Profiles (5) is reached,: the Add New Profile button will not be present, and the icon and the string described in note PRACC7.2 will not be present either. A text will be displayed instead informing the user they must first delete a Profile before creating a new one: “Max Profiles reached. Delete to create a new one.” (PU0584)
leaf_desc_037: When the Maximum number of Profiles (5) is reached,:A text will be displayed instead informing the user they must first delete a Profile before creating a new one: “Max Profiles reached. Delete to create a new one.” (PU0584)
reasoning: 驗證目標：5.2（PRACC8）末句 —— 達上限時改顯示一段告知使用者須先刪除之文字。關鍵情境條件：五個 profile 已存在（上限本身）。為什麼這樣切：**只驗「按鈕不見了」，一個什麼都不顯示之實作會通過** ——條文要求的是**替代顯示**，故本條必須獨立於 `021-02`。

tcs.tc_title: Max Profiles reached text shown in place of the Add New entry
tcs.test_item: Max Profiles reached text shown in place of the Add New entry
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Five Driver Profiles exist on the vehicle
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “All Profiles” tab
2. Read the screen and check the text shown in place of the Add New entry
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
2. The text “Max Profiles reached. Delete to create a new one.” (PU0584) is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: 字串與 PU id 逐字引自 5.2。與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-021-02` 之分野：該條驗**什麼不見了**，本條驗**取而代之顯示了什麼** —— 兩者為同一情境之兩個斷言，037 切兩個 leaf 故不合併（§8.2.1）。
